caveats.summary: PLUM omits at least 7 federal entities and at least 130 Senate-confirmed positions, and contains inconsistent identifiers and duplicate positions. OPM concurred with all recommendations. Absence from PLUM is therefore evidence of a gap in PLUM, not proof that an agency has no such positions.
